research: https://docs.cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/video/video-gen-prompt-guide — 'static shot (or fixed)' means the camera remains completely still; state it plainly ('The camera remains static'); avoid 'no/don't' instructions; dialogue as 'X says: line'

https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/ultimate-prompting-guide-for-veo-3-1 — formula Cinematography + Subject + Action + Context + Style; delivery notes go in the action ('says quietly'); timed segments ([00:00-00:03]) order actions inside 8 seconds

https://www.eachlabs.ai/blog/image-to-video-prompts-write-the-motion — the start frame already fixes subject and setting; re-describing it wastes the prompt; spend the words on how the scene changes over time
https://kling.ai/topics/image-to-video-prompts — one named motion, everything else held still, camera locked off; get the static version working before adding camera moves
https://magichour.ai/blog/image-to-video-prompts — subject action + environment + camera + timing; portraits: one blink, one small secondary motion, 'locked camera, subtle motion only'

https://www.veo3gen.app/blog/veo-31-imagetovideo-prompt-sandwich-a-3layer-template-to-animate-one-photo-witho — one primary action + locked-off camera + one subtle environmental change; name the camera constraint explicitly to stop drift and jitter

prompts.1A: Static locked-off shot; the camera stays completely still for the whole clip. One continuous take. Behind the rain-streaked conservatory glass, the man keeps his palm flat on the pane and gazes out, sorrowful. Rain runs steadily down the glass in thin rivulets. Around the fourth second he closes his eyes in one slow, heavy blink, then looks out again and holds. Solemn charity-appeal sincerity, quiet and still. Black and white monochrome film throughout, shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, natural motion blur. The camera remains static. Thanks.
